# 2dfx demonstrations

These are the final 1.1.4 demo programs and SHOW_FW screen builder, connected to the portable device through `twodfx_api.h`. `portable_support.h` supplies logical time and per-device entropy. State codecs at the end of each demo preserve its animation across device switches and snapshots. See `../../docs/EGGS.md` and `LICENSE_SCOPE.md`.
